title: Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya)
hook: Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya): Gupta Swarna Yug ke shikhar
exam_points: Western Kshatrapa Rudrasimha III ko haraya; Ujjain doosri rajdhani.
Chini yatri Fa-Hien (399-414 CE) ne yatra ki.
Navratna: Kalidasa, Amarasimha, Varahamihira aadi (parampara); Mehrauli Lauh Stambh (Chandra).
Putri Prabhavati Gupta ka vivah Vakataka Rudrasena II se.

mcqs.q: Fa-Hien kis Gupta raja ke samay aaya?
